subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay media from `requireMention` group messages that did not address the bot, and under what bounded retention and visibility policy?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but storing and replaying unmentioned group media can expose sensitive room content unless maintainers define the intended privacy boundary first.

options.title: Approve bounded retention
options.body: Allow a fix that records only authorized local image history media under existing group/context visibility rules, with strict media count, TTL, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Reject unmentioned media retention
options.body: Keep the current no-download behavior for unmentioned group media and document that this part of group history is text-only.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Add a narrow opt-in only if existing group-history policy is not enough to cover this privacy boundary by default.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded retention
recommendation.body: Allow a fix that records only authorized local image history media under existing group/context visibility rules, with strict media count, TTL, and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Telegram skip path and recent channel policy refactor point to this owner as the best first routing candidate for the decision.
